titre: White castled. Can you win a piece? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Scotch Game: White castles and every piece looks protected. But the knight takes, uncovers a bishop, and Black wins a whole piece. Better was taking the knight first. Seen in 4 real games at ~1400 (Lichess). Would you have seen Nxd5? 👇

Analyze your own game, free: https://blundercheck.app/try?src=youtube-en
